title: PORT-BRANCH-mcp-oauth-1: carry mcp-oauth-1 onto main
body:

**Trigger:** branch `mcp-oauth-1` at 8cf2aed3ad holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: .github/workflows/deploy-site.yml, dashboard/worker.js, site/oauth.js, site/oauth.test.mjs)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried mcp-oauth-1
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M
